move.subject: RFQ Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – lead time and terms
move.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Thank you for your quotation and your interest in the HX series.

Your supplier record sup:70240 lists a standard lead time of 42 days, so we ask you to confirm 42 days instead of the 52 days quoted. Your scorecard sc:70240@2026Q3 shows an on-time delivery of 62.5%, which is a risk we must price into our comparison. We have received several competitive offers for this part.

We have attached alternative packages for your review. Could you also share a short cost breakdown (material, machining, logistics) and let us know whether a cheaper variant is possible?

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
